article.story: Louisiana (1-0) at No. 14 USC (2-0), Sept. 12 at 11 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: USC by 30.5. Against the spread: USC 1-1, Louisiana 1-0. USC ranks 7th on offense, converting on 66.7% of third downs. Both teams have strong red zone defenses. USC is 24th in FBS, with opponents scoring on 60% of trips. Louisiana's red zone defense ranks 1st at 0%. USC is 11th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 38:04. Smith carried the ball 10 times for 84 yards and scored two touchdowns. Jensen had five receptions for 77 yards. Next game USC plays at Rutgers on Sept. 19. Louisiana hosts UAB on Sept. 19.
